'''Adeline Marr''' was a [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jun Seros (Jedi)|Jun Seros]] she led Republic agents to [[Grand Champions massacre|massacre]] several people in the search for the [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Marr joined the Jedi Order and served as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] around the year [[3641 BBY]]. During the later stages of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Marr was commanded by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jun Seros (Jedi)|Jun Seros]] to lead a cadre of [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[SIS shadow operative|shadow operatives]] to search for the [[Hunter (individual)|latest]] [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]], responsible for the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Jedi Master [[Kellian Jarro]], a close friend to Master Seros. Their search brought them to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where they stormed a party being hosted by [[Bloodworthy]], [[Jewl'a Nightbringer]] and the [[Defenestrator]] for the new Grand Champion. The bounty hunters refused to give up their comrade's whereabouts and were all killed in the [[Grand Champions massacre|ensuing fight]]. Adeline reported to Seros via holo about the apparent dead end when the Grand Champion arrived. Seros offered the bounty hunter one last chance to surrender, but the Champion refused, angered at their comrades' deaths. Before anyone could react, the Defenestrator's body activated a self-destruct, causing a brief confusion to allow the Grand Champion to kill Adeline and her allies.<ref name="Notorious" />

==Personality and traits==
A female Miraluka with [[Color/Legends|black]] hair and light skin, Marr was blind as is typical to all members of her [[Species/Legends|species]]. She wielded a blue [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in combat.<ref name="Notorious" />

==Behind the scenes==
Adeline Marr was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="TOR release">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20111220|text=''Star Wars'': The Old Republic Goes Live Today}}</ref> She appears in the Bounty Hunter class mission "Notorious," where the player is granted conversation options to try and settle with Marr and Jun Seros peacefully or with violence, but whichever option the player chooses, Seros always commands Adeline to attack the Bounty Hunter.<ref name="Notorious" />
